scope: Controlled direct/wrapper/unnamed-group/named-group cell hint contrasts; shared primitives and focus histories are calibration, not independent generalization.  Raw model inputs and contexts are retained; only DOM identity is adapted in the independent verification view. Reading-target agreement uses Native geometry/AX, not keyboard focus; it remains narrower than general logical-cursor Navigation Accuracy. Declared state fields, model-changing boolean transitions, keyboard focus and task outcomes are independently observed in both environments. Calibration final checked state is a fixture-health oracle, not successful user tasks. State changes are separately counted. Transfer tasks declare checked/disabled changes and save outcomes. Transition denominator records model-changing states, distinct from repeated state-field snapshots; it does not measure text selections, values or a general transition model. Literal Full compares actual model windows with differing observation durations; no queue/completion/timing parity claim. All planned failures/missing/unmeasured rows retained. Now inspected regression; no broad 90% or representative-web claim.

plan.sourceState: Collection worktree with AX schema v6 table metadata and cell input verification; earlier pending cursor diagnostics retained. Full source/build hashes preserved, not a pristine commit build.

reservation.scope: New task bodies, histories, outcomes and bytes reserved before new table-checkbox Native calibration. Shared primitives/contexts are not global structural independence. Old table AX-only smoke uses already-inspected pages and does not inspect these inputs.

ui.control: Press Tab to highlight each item on a webpage

safariTabPreference.scope: Guest Safari actual checkbox control; no other settings asserted.

plan.question: Does isolated checkbox Space/VO activation emit the same state receipt in flat, table and named-context table layouts?
plan.hypothesis: A grouping object between cell and checkbox may suppress the cell location hint; distinguish an ordinary wrapper, an unnamed explicit group and a named explicit group with otherwise identical HTML/control/histories. Native AX cell ranges/header references must establish used inputs independently; keep missing data unmeasured. Do not change sources/model or inspect one profile outcomes until both Native profiles finish.
plan.protocol: Same shared HTML and complete command sequences in both Native browsers. Freeze actual Rawstep model outputs, semantic inputs, previous speech contexts and independent renderer DOM/control state before Native. Rawstep owns movement; no new navigation implementation. Speech data never selects targets or supplies model inputs.
plan.inputPolicy: Preserve exact diagnostic input and previousContext. For the Native verifier only, join the actual model target backendDOMNodeId to its independently read renderer DOM id; retain both original identity and mapping. This ID-only verification view does not alter model input or prediction. Container IDs retain actual model identities. Native target and previous ancestor context still require independent geometry/AX confirmation.
metrics: literal Full Speech Exact of actual model windows
plan.limits: Controlled one-factor contexts for calibration; reserved distinct task structures/histories for transfer. Shared primitives do not establish global structural independence. The fixed input reservation predates new Native calibration. The unchanged enabled-state oracle only checks fixture health, not task-generalization performance. A diagnostic input is not an AX/VO cursor oracle. Model 900ms observation windows and Native bounded receipt windows do not establish equal timing, causal attribution, completion or native queue behavior. Preserve every failed/missing/unmeasured row.

acquisition.scope: One-factor cell/group hint calibration after inspected transfer failures. Exact same control, cell, title and complete focus sequence. Only ordinary wrapping, explicit group role and group name vary. Both profiles finish before inspecting outcomes or changing sources/model.
acquisition.protocolClarification: The reused frozen plan question mentions state events; this cohort measures Tab/Shift+Tab hints and has no activation or state-change command. Its fixed case set, grouping hypothesis and this pre-Native clarification define the experiment; original plan/predictions are unchanged.
